correctness.rationale: Over C with d≥6 the six Taylor coefficients in degrees 0–5 are the power moments of the distinct ratios v_i/p_i, each weighted by the sum of p_i^d on its block. Their first k equations have invertible k-by-k Vandermonde matrix since k≤6. Each resulting block sum is zero, so singleton blocks are impossible, and the one full-support block would give the zero direction modulo p. Conversely the exact restriction is t^d times the sum of w_i^d on the zero-coordinate complement; this proves the contact gap, including d=6. For a fixed partition and size-two root choices, the marked-point base is the open projectivized product of block cones, of dimension |T|-k-1. A block hypersurface of positive dimension in projective space is irreducible here because it is smooth and any distinct positive-degree factors would meet. The direction space is the projectivization of the rank k+|R|-1 bundle obtained by quotienting the allowed vector bundle by the tautological point line. Its dimension k+|R|-2 gives total dimension three. The exact support, pair-root ratios, and generic equality classes of the slopes are intrinsic; if two closures coincided their dense constructible loci of distinct block slopes would meet, contradicting recovery of that data. An independent recursion assigning each label to an existing block, a new block or the complement reproduced the nine shape counts 15,20,15,6,45,60,15,10,15 in the source order. Multiplication by d for each pair block gives 15d³+45d²+90d+51, with 5451 at d=6. These are reduced-locus statements only.
residual_risks: Neither the finite check nor the proof establishes the scheme structure of the nonreduced contact locus.

value.rationale: The dimension theorem leaves the geometry of the special Fermat locus open. The partition-and-root classification supplies all topological components, including those generically not contained in the hypersurface, and it detects an actual contact-order gap. These are concrete invariants for comparing general and special contact loci, beyond recounting the classical planes.
residual_risks: No multiplicities or intersection theory for the individual components is inferred.
